scope: Durable scan-review cleanup after garment sync acknowledgement, including retry with no cloud queue remaining

before.scope: Repeated final acknowledgement and failed marker write

behavior: A successful garment action and its review-cleanup journal ID are persisted together before any review files are removed
Cleanup errors retain the journal and original review for replay
A journal-only sync does not repeat cloud writes; boot rehydration bypasses the TTL guard for pending cleanup
Matching stable garment IDs acknowledge only those review candidates; saved markers are read back before success
A failed journal-clear write restores entries; replay and completed-review acknowledgements are idempotent
Logout resets journal state with other owner data
limits: Fresh-process recovery used actual production modules through real OS-file adapters, with simulated cloud confirmation; no native/UI/provider claim
Physical iOS/Android flow and native crash/storage matrix remain incomplete
Old pre-journal already-confirmed items may require reopening their editor; no broad migration of legacy reviews was performed
Client changes not distributed; not 10000 DAU certification
